description: This file contains controller functions for denormalizing data related to projects, commits, and diff targets in a repository analysis application. It orchestrates various denormalization processes such as recent project views, diff rows, and commit data, utilizing repositories and interactors.

methods.name: DenormalizeData
methods.description: Main entry point to trigger various denormalization processes asynchronously.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentProject
methods.description: Denormalizes the most recent project view for each diff target in the configuration.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentProjectForTarget
methods.description: Denormalizes recent project view data for a specific diff target.

methods.name: denormalizeDiffRows
methods.description: Denormalizes diff rows for each target in the configuration.

methods.name: denormalizeDiffRowsForTarget
methods.description: Denormalizes diff rows for a specific target.

methods.name: getMappedTarget
methods.description: Converts a DiffTarget to a MappedDiffTarget using the source repository.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentCommit
methods.description: Denormalizes recent commit data for each diff target and global top committers and tech areas.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentCommitGlobal
methods.description: Denormalizes global top committers and tech areas.

methods.name: denormalizeCommitRows
methods.description: Denormalizes recent commit data for a specific target.

methods.name: extractCommitHashes
methods.description: Extracts commit hashes from commit rows.
